caption: This is an approximate guide to help you shortlist. Fabric fall, embroidery detail and length will differ in person.

errors.title: Your try-ons didn't load
errors.description: The connection dropped on the way. Try again — nothing has been lost.
errors.RESULT_NOT_FOUND: That try-on is no longer here. The rest are in your try-ons.
errors.RESULT_NOT_OWNED: That try-on is no longer here. The rest are in your try-ons.
errors.SHORTLIST_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: That piece isn't on your shortlist. Open your shortlist to see what is there.
errors.GARMENT_NOT_FOUND: That piece has left the collection. Your try-on is unaffected.
errors.FILE_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This image link has expired. Reload the page to get a fresh one.
errors.FILE_TOKEN_INVALID: This image link isn't valid. Reload the page.
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't load that image. Reload the page.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You're going a bit fast. Give it a minute and try again.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to see your try-ons.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and we'll bring you back here.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is on hold. Contact the studio and we'll sort it out.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. We'll load these when you're back.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We're briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Your try-ons didn't load. Try again — we've been notified.
